label: AbiG system
definition: An abortive infection system in which an organism possesses a two-gene abiG locus with abiGi and abiGii open reading frames, exemplified by the Lactococcus lactis subsp. cremoris UC653 plasmid pCI750 locus that restricts lactococcal phages without blocking phage DNA replication and is represented by the DefenseFinder AbiG__AbiGi and AbiG__AbiGii profiles.
observations: AbiG branch under abortive infection system; distinct from individual abiGi or abiGii genes, AbiGi or AbiGii proteins, the pCI750 plasmid, the DefenseFinder AbiG__AbiGi and AbiG__AbiGii HMM profiles, source database rows naming one AbiG locus, phage sk1 or c2 RNA synthesis as a process, individual lactococcal phage host-range outcomes, unresolved AbiG triggers or arrest targets, and generic abortive infection systems.
